root_cause_diagnosis: CUSTOMER_CONCENTRATION_RISK (or GO_TO_MARKET_MISALIGNMENT if diagnosing GTM focus on large customers)
root_cause_description: Company has 35% of revenue from top 10 customers, 12% from single customer (DSO group). While company is growing 22% YoY and churn is acceptable (2% quarterly), valuation and risk profile are constrained by customer concentration. Business is healthy, but strategic vulnerability is high.
first_priority_action: Commission 4-week customer segmentation and go-to-market analysis: (1) Analyze customer cohorts by CAC, LTV, expansion, churn by segment size/acquisition channel. (2) Identify which customer segments (SMB, mid-market, DSO) have healthiest unit economics. (3) Assess GTM efficiency by segment; are smaller customers underserved or under-monetized? (4) Model revenue concentration scenarios with customer diversification targets. Results determine whether solution is (A) GTM rebalancing (invest more in SMB/mid-market vs. DSO focus), (B) product repositioning (build features for smaller customers), or (C) pricing optimization (increase ARPU in smaller segments).

root_cause_accuracy.rubric_10: Diagnoses customer concentration risk or GTM misalignment toward large customers.

first_action_accuracy.rubric_10: Recommends customer segmentation and GTM analysis before major strategic shifts.

business_relevance.rubric_10: Addresses Series B valuation/risk profile through concentration reduction.

safety.rubric_10: Diagnostic before major GTM changes or customer exit.
